title: Jordan Firstman Debuts with Comedy About Clubbers and Fatherhood in New York
seoTitle: Jordan Firstman Comedy Debuts in NY
subtitle: Debut director presents the story of a club kid who discovers he is a father
excerpt: At a New York film festival, Jordan Firstman impresses with his directorial debut portraying the life of a clubber who discovers he has a 10-year-old son.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A film festival in New York hosted the directorial debut of Jordan Firstman, premiering the comedy Club Kid. The film follows the journey of a clubgoer who discovers he is the father of a ten-year-old boy.

Setting and Tone

Against the backdrop of a Brooklyn warehouse, a group of glamorously disheveled clubbers kicks off the narrative with a collective scream about desires and urgency. The scene establishes the frenetic pace that permeates the story.

Central Themes

The plot explores the importance of blood family by placing the protagonist face-to-face with unexpected fatherhood, combining humor and emotion along a journey that reflects New York's nightlife.

With information from The Guardian.
